column1: # assets/everything.tsv: every optional part of a run, and what EVERYTHING=true (scripts/run-all.sh) and
# -profile everything (conf/everything.config) do with it. One row per item; `og dev everything-check` fails when
# main.nf, nextflow.config, run-all.sh, setup.sh or versions.env gains an item with no row here.
# kind: tool (a main.nf --tools name: EVERYTHING names it), switch (a run-all.sh switch: EVERYTHING sets it to
#   value), setup (a setup.sh flag: value names the rows whose data it installs), input (a choice or a file only
#   the user can give: EVERYTHING leaves it to them), image (an optional image of versions.env: value names the row
#   whose step runs it), excluded (left out: reason says why).
# value: tool and input rows: how to install the data, '-' when none is needed; switch rows: the value EVERYTHING
#   sets; setup and image rows: the rows they serve, comma separated.
# setup.sh --everything runs the setup rows from top to bottom after base setup.
# nextflow: switch rows with a Nextflow parameter: that parameter as conf/everything.config sets it, else '-'.
# Rows named --<param> stand for a Nextflow parameter that has no run-all.sh switch.
